craft_notes: Sthāyin: city-of-kalā (twelve-end + silver-hued moon — the moon-image of emancipation: mokṣa in silver, not void). Sanskrit: kalānagarasyānte dvādaśānte...śvetavarṇā...muktipadasya...bhavet → L4 keeps kalā-city line 1, emancipation-form line 2. Rows: row 3 (understanding→form). Close: form (rūpa — emancipation's OWN FORM: freedom has a color (silver) and a face: kept concrete). Rejected: 'chandra-bindu visualization' jargon — killed: silver-hued kept (the COLOR is the point); '12th kalā' numbers-only — kept at twelfth (the number-with-kalā-context kept both).

lines: understanding the city's form — emancipation's own form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yad avedyaṃ yad agrāhyaṃ yac chūnyaṃ yad abhāvagam | tat sarvam bhairavam bhāvyaṃ tadante bodhasambhavaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is to be contemplated? → Contemplating everything as Bhairava, awakening arises at that end.
c1_essence: Unknowable, ungraspable, void: as Bhairava — awakening rises.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta undertow (resolve laid quiet)
